dependency: Agreed integration and actual sheet whole-boundary-to-region-to-hatch receiver; reuse doc/profile_refs.rs strict matcher, with no second matcher.
scope: Future composed acceptance; no assertion that the receiver or saved-fill records currently exist.

creation_variants.name: bare_strings
creation_variants.coordinate_encoding: Bare decimal strings in paper mm; e.g. 40 and string 40 both mean 40 mm on the sheet

geometry.authored_right_vertex_x: Retain the Width expression using the existing W38a expression representation; do not bake resolved values or invent a new payload field.

analytic_derivation.stroke_count: 10 base members + 2 hole1 splits + 2 hole2 splits = 14
analytic_derivation.endpoint_rule: At each member y, begin with [0,Width]; remove [8,12] for 4<y<8 and [24,30] for 10<y<14. Compare every resulting endpoint and stroke, not just totals.
analytic_derivation.oracle_origin: Independent rectangle arithmetic; no implementation output or generated golden.

read_only_resolution_checks.snapshot_timing: For each creation variant and each width state, snapshot immediately after the intentional source edit and before resolving; compare immediately after resolution.
read_only_resolution_checks.source_document: unchanged by resolution, including parameter expressions, units and model features
read_only_resolution_checks.source_history: unchanged by resolution; the intentional Width edit is outside this comparison
read_only_resolution_checks.authored_sheet_record: unchanged by resolution, including point/curve IDs and Width expressions
read_only_resolution_checks.requested_boundary: same canonical outer and all hole identities in both states
read_only_resolution_checks.variant_equivalence: Both creation variants produce the same analytic region and hatch in each state.

unit_control: Do not interpret explicitly authored Width=40 in as40 mm; this fixture deliberately uses40 mm and60 mm while display units are inches.
excluded_claims: Persistence or undo qualification for future fill records
next_actor: Engineer decides when the composed receiver is integrated and grants implementation/validation; Kernel Specialist remains quiet and available.
